thread:
Ava: quick flag — the autoscale SLO card is cramped on narrow modals. min/max slider, pool selector and the burst pill are squished into one line and the burst overlaps helper text on <720px. screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/ux/22475
Ravi: saw that in staging. VoiceOver reads helper then the overlapping chip, which is confusing.
Leo: can you confirm this is the detail SLO card (not the compact table)?
Ava: detail card. uploaded two captures for 1280x720 modal and iPad split.
design-bot: uploaded files: slo_card_narrow.png, slo_card_ipad.png
Maya: thought: hiding burst in an overflow reduces clutter but makes an important control harder to find during incidents.
Leo: burst has operational impact (temp GPUs = cost + latency change). keep visible if possible.
Ravi: responsive approach: use flex-wrap so when container <700px burst moves to a second, tight row under the sliders. keeps visibility and avoids overlap.
Ava: OK but visually it must feel like the same control group. compact spacing and a subtle divider should be avoided.
Noor: accessibility: ensure tab order remains logical (min -> max -> burst -> pool -> save). add aria-describedby on burst to the short helper: "Temporary capacity for short bursts; may increase cost." and ensure screen reader announces when layout changes.
Maya: copy: don't rename main label. add a short tooltip instead: tooltip text as Noor suggested.
Leo: implementation note: CSS: `display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; align-items:center;` slider container `flex:1 1 320px;` burst pill `flex:0 0 auto;`. i'll prototype and test at 320/480/720 breakpoints.
design-bot: created branch feature/slo-card-wrap-22475
Maya: microtest idea: 1) set min=1 max=4, 2) enable burst, 3) switch GPU pool. time to completion + any focus jumping. 3 engineers, 15 mins.
Ava: please attach prototype screenshots and results. Noor will run a quick SR/keyboard pass after the microtest.
Noor: will verify keyboard nav, VoiceOver order, and aria-describedby. reporting back EOW.
Ravi: :thumbsup:
Ava: thanks everyone — i'll update the product spec with the responsive rule and tooltip copy.
